document.abstract: JVC1 has developed a fully digital drive D-ILA LCOS microdisplay device, which has a native resolution of full HD (1920 times 1080 pixels) and contrast ratio greater than 5000:1. The new devices have been combined in 3 device RGB configuration with advanced video processing circuitry for consumer rear projection TV applications.
